protocol.scope: Previously observed normal data and synthetic changes; no independent failure validation

frequency.short_records: Unchanged and retained in all denominators
frequency.interpretation: Whole-record sine reconstruction; retrospective sensor/drive sensitivity, not causal online signal transformation

injection_definitions.slow_vibration_level_ramp: Signed additive ramp, reaches strength * training within-record AC RMS after 20 post-onset samples and then stays constant
injection_definitions.intermittent_zeroing: Zero selected sensor for strength samples every 10 post-onset samples; seed fixes phase; timestamps/rows retained
injection_definitions.gradual_current_amplitude_reduction: Linearly reduce current AC about frozen training mean by strength over 20 post-onset samples, then hold
injection_definitions.controls: Same unmodified recording; alarms counted only from onset to recording end; pre-onset arrays must be byte-identical
injection_definitions.scales: Fit on the original A or B normal training records only; no per-evaluation-record centering
injection_definitions.continuous_deltas: Retained after original matched input quantization, as in the original causal injection experiment

leave_one_family_out.gates: Original selectable and gate_pass flags unchanged
leave_one_family_out.selection_role: Descriptive stability audit; original selected candidate remains fixed

calibration_contamination.records: First 1/2/5 calibration recordings with at least 8 rows
calibration_contamination.statistic: Replace only calibration record maxima; fit, branch scales, candidates and alpha remain fixed
calibration_contamination.evaluations: Unmodified normal test records and the already fixed new-family injections
